components.html: Recording

narrative.overview: Compact is Freehand's native Avalonia design. A graphite window, centered text tabs, readable transcript rows, and restrained sage actions support a daily, tray-first dictation workflow. Windows retains its title bar and window controls. The application requests the dark Fluent theme.
dos: Do keep routine dictation in the tray and preserve the receiving app's focus.
Do use native tokens and Fluent controls when adding or changing a view.
Do pair red recording and amber attention with explicit text.
Do preserve real history, dictionary, settings, and recovery behavior.
donts: Don't add recorder textures, bevels, decorative labels, or browser demo controls.
Don't treat a headless capture as hardware validation, installation, or publication.
